title: Image-gen catalog seeding: extend hydrate + sync paths to image/tts/asr/video
description:
User reports image generation still not working in Course Builder + Classroom views (loop iteration 2026-05-07).

ROOT CAUSE (Explore agent investigation, this session):
`deeptutor/services/config/model_catalog.py` has TWO parallel seed paths (gotcha #63) — `_hydrate_missing_services_from_env()` (~line 138) and `_sync_active_services_from_env()` (~line 230 with nested ensure_*_profile helpers ~245-322). Both ONLY seed llm/embedding/search. They never create profiles for image/tts/asr/video.

On a fresh install with no on-disk model_catalog.json, both paths run. The catalog saves with `image: { profiles: [] }`, so `activeProfileFor('image', 'openrouter-image')` in `web/lib/server/provider-config.ts` (~line 470) returns null. The fallback then tries env vars, which may not be set if relying on catalog-first resolution.

ALSO: `deeptutor/services/config/env_store.py` uses `@dataclass(slots=True)` ConfigSummary with ONLY llm/embedding/search fields. ENV_KEY_ORDER also lacks IMAGE_*/TTS_*/ASR_* keys. So even adding seed paths needs env_store extended in lockstep — render_from_catalog() and render_from_draft() both lift llm/embedding/search; they need image/tts/asr arms too. Not a 5-minute change; high blast radius.

ALSO: `_test_image()` in test_runner.py likely falls back to /images/generations for OpenRouter — gotcha #65 says OpenRouter has no such endpoint. Probe should only hit /chat/completions for OpenRouter image models.

FILES TO TOUCH (rough estimate):
- deeptutor/services/config/env_store.py — ConfigSummary +image/tts/asr fields, ENV_KEY_ORDER +IMAGE_*/TTS_*/ASR_*, render_from_catalog()/render_from_draft() arms
- deeptutor/services/config/model_catalog.py — _hydrate_missing_services_from_env() image/tts/asr blocks, _sync_active_services_from_env() ensure_image_profile/ensure_tts_profile/ensure_asr_profile helpers (~50 lines each)
- deeptutor/services/config/test_runner.py — _test_image() OpenRouter branch should not fall back to /images/generations

VERIFICATION:
- `cat data/user/settings/model_catalog.json | jq '.services.image'` should show a profile after restart
- POST to /api/generate/course-illustration should 200 instead of 401/500
- Settings UI Image tab should show provider/model selectors instead of empty

UNRELATED VERIFICATION FIRST: before doing the catalog work, verify the production deploy on Pironman actually has the image model configured. `ssh pironman 'sudo cat /home/matthewwagner/homelab/deeptutor/data/user/settings/model_catalog.json | jq .services.image'`. title: Triage 28 dependabot alerts on default branch (7 high, 21 moderate)
description:
GitHub flagged 28 vulnerabilities on the default branch after pulling upstream sync (DeepTutor v1.3.2 + OpenMAIC v0.2.1). All are pre-existing in upstream, not introduced by our fork.

**High-severity (7):**
- vite (2): `server.fs.deny` bypassed with queries (GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r); arbitrary file read via dev-server WebSocket (GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583) — services/openmaic/pnpm-lock.yaml
- path-to-regexp: DoS via sequential optional groups (GHSA-j3q9-mxjg-w52f) — services/openmaic/pnpm-lock.yaml
- picomatch: ReDoS via extglob quantifiers (GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj) — services/openmaic/pnpm-lock.yaml
- flatted: Prototype Pollution via parse() (GHSA-rf6f-7fwh-wjgh) — services/openmaic/pnpm-lock.yaml
- lodash.template: Command Injection (GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm) — services/openmaic/pnpm-lock.yaml
- 1 more

**Moderate-severity (21):** postcss (XSS, line-return parsing), uuid (buffer bounds), hono (6 separate alerts: HTML injection, cookie handling, IP matching, path traversal, repeated-slash bypass), @hono/node-server (repeated-slash bypass), langsmith (2: token redaction bypass, prototype pollution), brace-expansion (memory exhaustion), picomatch (POSIX class injection), yaml (stack overflow via deep nesting), vite (path traversal in .map), path-to-regexp (multi-wildcard ReDoS) — mostly services/openmaic/pnpm-lock.yaml; 2 also surface in web/package-lock.json (postcss, uuid).

**Triage approach:**
1. Bucket each alert as dev-only (vite, picomatch, brace-expansion, etc. — only run during build/test) vs runtime (hono, langsmith, postcss runtime, lodash.template if reachable).
2. For runtime alerts, check actual reachability — most hono advisories require a deploy that uses hono's HTTP server, which OpenMAIC does not.
3. For genuinely reachable runtime alerts, run `pnpm update` / `npm update` to bump transitive deps; if upstream pins block updates, file an upstream issue.

Full alert list: `gh api repos/mattwag05/DeepTutor/dependabot/alerts --paginate`
Dashboard: https://github.com/mattwag05/DeepTutor/security/dependabot

Most are in transitive deps via OpenMAIC's pnpm tree — upstream OpenMAIC may already be fixing some. Check upstream commits before bumping locally.
close_reason: Runtime-reachable alerts fixed via pnpm/npm overrides (uuid/postcss/langsmith). Ollama models (medgemma1.5+gemma4+gemma4:26b) cherry-picked upstream. CLAUDE.md corrected (IP+path). Deployed to Pironman — both containers healthy, DeepTutor integration healthy.

description:

- VJTiWmw-dt0TV8AIqs05- ('Point-of-Care Ultrasound Physics & Practice') — 3 blocks

ssh pironman 'cat /home/matthewwagner/homelab/deeptutor/data/courses/<COURSE_ID>.json' | \
  python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"{b['id']}|{(b.get('prompt') or '').replace(chr(10),' ')}\") for sec in d['sections'] for b in sec['blocks'] if b.get('type')=='illustration' and b.get('pending')]" | \

title: Mobile: viewport meta missing interactiveWidget=resizes-content
description:
app/layout.tsx exports viewport without interactiveWidget. The default behavior on Chromium and modern Safari is resizes-visual, meaning when the on-screen keyboard opens, position:fixed bottom elements (chat composer, AdvanceBar, More-sheet, mobile bottom nav) stay anchored to the *layout* viewport and end up obscured behind the keyboard.

Setting interactiveWidget:'resizes-content' resizes the layout viewport so fixed-bottom elements rise above the keyboard. Progressive enhancement: Chromium supports it natively, iOS Safari is gaining support, older browsers ignore it.

title: Investigate beads auto-export warning: git add fails on every bd write
description:
Every bd write operation (create/update/close/dep add/supersede) emits:

  Warning: auto-export: git add failed: exit status 1

after writing the JSONL export. Beads functions correctly otherwise — issues persist via the embedded Dolt database — but the git-side ledger (.beads/issues.jsonl) never gets staged, so the issue tree isn't visible in regular git review.

ROOT CAUSE (provisional):
.git/info/exclude lists .beads/ paths — the local-only ignore. git add silently refuses ignored paths. Verified via:
  git check-ignore -v .beads/issues.jsonl
    → .git/info/exclude:9: .beads/  .beads/issues.jsonl
  git check-ignore -v .beads/.gitignore .beads/embeddeddolt
    → both also ignored via the same line

The repo's tracked .gitignore (project root) only excludes .beads-credential-key, NOT .beads/, and CLAUDE.md (Issue Tracking section) explicitly says '.beads/ is tracked. bd ready after git pull to refresh.' So the .git/info/exclude entry contradicts the project convention.

LIKELY FIX:
1. Remove the .beads/ line from .git/info/exclude (it's local-only, not committed, so each clone may need this)
2. Verify .beads/.gitignore (already in repo) correctly carves out the bits that SHOULD stay local: dolt/, embeddeddolt/, bd.sock*, sync-state.json, last-touched, .exclusive-lock — yes, it does
3. After removing the exclude line, the next bd write should successfully stage .beads/issues.jsonl, and a follow-up commit captures the running issue ledger

ALTERNATIVE (don't do this): disable bd's auto-export to git via 'bd config set auto-export false' — silences the warning but loses git-side visibility into issue history, which is the whole point of the JSONL export.

VERIFICATION:
- After fix: 'bd create --title=test' should not emit the warning
- 'git status' should show .beads/issues.jsonl as modified after a bd write
- bd dolt remote (https://github.com/mattwag05/DeepTutor.git) is correct per CLAUDE.md post-2026-04-17 GitHub migration — not the cause

NOT URGENT: bd works fine today via the Dolt path; this is hygiene.
notes: Fixed 2026-05-04: removed .beads/ from .git/info/exclude. Tracked .gitignore only excludes .beads-credential-key (intended scope). git check-ignore -v on .beads/issues.jsonl now returns nothing (no rule matches), confirming the auto-export warning is gone.
close_reason: Removed .beads/ from .git/info/exclude. Verified: check-ignore on .beads/issues.jsonl now matches no rule; bd writes no longer emit the auto-export warning. .beads/embeddeddolt remains ignored via .beads/.gitignore (correct — only the JSONL export should be tracked).
